name: Manel Rosa
description: Comedian Manel Rosa performs a stand-up comedy show at Alameda Shop & Spot as part of the Alameda Comedy Club series.
longDescription:
Manel Rosa brings his stand-up comedy to Alameda Shop & Spot on 27 November at 21:00. His performance marks the final night of the six-show Alameda Comedy Club series held at the shopping centre.

Admission is free, but space is limited. Entry requires registration through the Alameda mobile application, with tickets restricted to a double ticket per person.
descriptionPt: O humorista Manel Rosa apresenta um espetáculo de stand-up comedy no Alameda Shop & Spot, integrado no ciclo Alameda Comedy Club.
longDescriptionPt:
Manel Rosa leva o seu stand-up comedy ao Alameda Shop & Spot a 27 de novembro, às 21h00. A atuação encerra o ciclo de seis noites do Alameda Comedy Club no centro comercial.

A entrada é gratuita, mas os lugares são limitados. O acesso exige reserva através da aplicação móvel do Alameda, com o limite de um bilhete duplo por pessoa.
